summary: 26-year-old woman died in an ~500-ft free-solo fall on the Four Aces of Blitzen Ridge, Ypsilon Mountain; her uninjured partner was hoisted out by a CO Air National Guard helicopter, body recovered by long-line to Upper Beaver Meadows
location: Four Aces of Blitzen Ridge, Ypsilon Mountain, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park SAR, Colorado Air National Guard; RMNP Search and Rescue; Colorado Air National Guard (Buckley AFB); Northern Colorado Interagency Helitak; Flight for Life; RMNP Search and Rescue + CO Air National Guard, Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Northern Colorado Interagency Helitak, Flight for Life, Larimer County Coroner
